newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: CREDITORS SUPPLY FUNDS TO S.KOREA DAINONG, MIDOPA.
newsitem.headline: CREDITORS SUPPLY FUNDS TO S.KOREA DAINONG, MIDOPA.

text.p: Creditors of South Korea's Dainong Group have supplied 15.9 billion won in emergency funds to Dainong Corp and Midopa Department Store, an official at Dainong's main creditor SEOULBANK said on Thursday.
He said 5.7 billion won had been given to Dainong Corp and 10.2 billion to Midopa on Tuesday.
The amount of the emergency loans was decided in late May after Midopa, Dainong and two other Dainong Group units were designated for a bail-out.
The funds were supplied after the group met creditors' demand that it turn over management control to creditors.
